summary: Local TypeScript-check exit 127 now reports the caller environment and web shell hook state to investigate #4659; the underlying incident remains open.

schema.detail: No stored or wire schema changes. A temporary diagnostic report is local to one check run.

rules.detail: No check, skip, signing, retry or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The check command and failed status are unchanged. On exit 127, additional output shows caller PATH and BASH_ENV and the web shell hook's start/end markers, tool resolution and publisher status. Hook snapshots precede child Bash startup. The report is bounded to 16 KiB when displayed; no rerun is performed.

manual.detail: No action required. The runner supplies the temporary report path; developer shells produce no additional output when it is unset.

recovery.detail: Revert the build to remove the additional diagnostics. No application data is changed or deleted.
